components.description: Dense time series: each row folds its value into 3 colour bands of the same height, so many series fit in little space. Diverging mirrors negative values in a second hue. Use for 4–20 series where a line chart would overlap. React: <HorizonChart data={[{ series, date, value }]} bands={3} mode="positive | diverging" />

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Same band size for every row, stated in the legend.
Row height ≥ 24 px on mobile; fewer rows rather than thinner ones.
Sort rows by peak time or total, not alphabetically, when the pattern matters.
Always give the exact value in the tooltip.
How to read it
Darker = higher. Each band is folded on top of the one below, so a full dark row means the value passed 3 bands.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
